38void Device::initializeAsynchronousEngine(uint8_t maximumQueueLength) {
39 telemetryQueueHandle = xQueueCreate(maximumQueueLength, sizeof(TelemetryPackage*));
40
41 xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(&Device::executeHardwareSamplingContext, "HardwareWorker", 4096, this, 3, &hardwareSamplingTaskHandle, 1);
42 xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(&Device::executeNetworkDispatchContext, "NetworkWorker", 8192, this, 1, &networkDispatcherTaskHandle, 1);
43
44 hardwareTimer = timerBegin(hardwareTimerIndex, 80, true);
45 timerAttachInterruptArg(hardwareTimer, &Device::handleHardwareTimerInterrupt, this, true);
46
47 uint64_t alarmIntervalInMicroseconds = static_cast<uint64_t>(pollingIntervalInMilliseconds) * 1000;
48 timerAlarmWrite(hardwareTimer, alarmIntervalInMicroseconds, true);
49 timerAlarmEnable(hardwareTimer);
50}

52bool Device::appendSensorToScheduler(EventHandler* targetSensorInstance, int requestedEventIdentifier) {

66void Device::executeHardwareSamplingContext(void* taskParameters) {
67 Device* self = static_cast<Device*>(taskParameters);
68 while (true) {
69 ulTaskNotifyTake(pdTRUE, portMAX_DELAY);
70
71 if (self->registeredSlotCount > 0) {
72 uint8_t currentSlotIndex = self->activeSequencePointer;
73 ScheduledTaskSlot activeTask = self->scheduledSequences[currentSlotIndex];
74
75 if (activeTask.sensorInstance != nullptr) {
76 activeTask.sensorInstance->on(Event(activeTask.targetEventIdentifier));
77 }
78
79 self->activeSequencePointer = (currentSlotIndex + 1) % self->registeredSlotCount;
80 }
81 }
82}

84void Device::executeNetworkDispatchContext(void* taskParameters) {
85 Device* self = static_cast<Device*>(taskParameters);
86 TelemetryPackage* incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer = nullptr;
87
88 while (true) {
89 if (xQueueReceive(self->telemetryQueueHandle, &incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer, portMAX_DELAY) == pdPASS) {
90 if (incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer != nullptr) {
91 self->processQueuedTelemetryData(incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer);
92 delete incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer;
93 incomingPolymorphicPacketPointer = nullptr;
94 }
95 }
96 }
